name: Summit AZ - Striking Distance Keywords 2026-10-03
body:
> Research · Summit Az · 2026-10-03

# Summary
Every keyword sitting at GSC position 8 to 20 on Oct 3, 2026, used to pick the next rewrite batch. Three files: `Summit-AZ-Striking-Distance-Keywords-Sitewide-2026-10-03.csv` (281 keywords with impressions, clicks, position), `Summit-AZ-Striking-Distance-Keywords-by-URL-2026-10-03.csv` (358 keyword and page pairs) and `Summit-AZ-Striking-Distance-Sheet-2026-10-03.html` (an HTML view of the same data).

# Key findings
- Top terms by impressions: "emergency plumber tempe" (489, position 19), "summit plumbing pros llc reviews" (118, 9), "plumbing repair" (69, 19), "sewer line repair mesa" (62, 16), "emergency plumber near me" (61, 8), "drain cleaning fountain hills" (51, 10), "water heater installation queen creek" (49, 17), "sewer line repair fountain hills" (46, 10), "slab leak repair apache junction" (41, 9).
- Pages with the most striking-distance pairs: the homepage (26), leak detection Tempe (21), the Tempe general hub (18), Orangeburg Mesa (16), leak detection Chandler (15), and tankless, leak detection STV and QC pages (13 each).
- Emergency terms are high on the list but wait on the emergency-search strategy decision.

# Decisions and status
- Batch chosen: the 3 pages with the most approved-service keywords at positions 8 to 13: drain cleaning Fountain Hills, sewer line repair Fountain Hills and sewer line repair Queen Creek. All three rewritten and live Oct 3 (shared copy cut from 40 to 63% to under 5%).
- Measure at 28 days: "drain cleaning fountain hills" (8), "sewer line repair fountain hills" (10), "trenchless sewer repair queen creek" (8).
